授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course will provide an overview of the basic knowledge of the chemical basis and biological regulatory functions of various food components. This course will help students to understand the effects of food components that contribute to health promotion. This lecture will be held consecutively with the Food Science I course. Please register for Food Science I.
By taking this course, students will gain an accurate understanding of information about the structure and function of food components and establish scientific bases that will be useful for future study and graduation research.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: food components, chemical compositions, health-supporting effect, functioal foods, mechanism
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Having taken the Food Science I course.
